entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- APPLICATION U/S 482 No. - 5387 of 2024 Applicant :- Pratyush Srivastava And Another Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Neeraj Kumar Saxena,Eshan Kumar Gupta,Gaurav Saxena,Jushi Saxen Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajnish Kumar,J.
Heard Sri Dhawal Prakash,Advocate holding brief of Sri Neeraj Kumar Saxena, learned counsel for the applicants and learned AGA.

Instant petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been preferred by the applicants/petitioners for quashing of the impugned charge-sheet in case crime no. 237 of 2023, under Section 498A,323,504,506 IPC & Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station-Kotwali Sadar,
District-Lakhimpur Kheri.

After arguing at some length, learned counsel for the applicants/petitioners confines his prayer that the applicants will file bail applications before the learned trial court which may be directed to be decided in accordance with the law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Satender Pratyush Srivastava And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko ... on 12 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88822825/
1 Kumar Antil versus Central Bureau of Investigation and another;(2021) 10 SCC 773.
Learned A.G.A. has no objection to the prayer made by learned counsel for the applicants/petitioners.

entities.text: Satender Pratyush Srivastava And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Kumar Antil versus Central Bureau of Investigation and another;(2021) 10 SCC 773
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
On due consideration of the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, it is provided that in case, the applicants/petitioners move bail applications before the trial court within fifteen days'
from today, the same shall be considered and decided within a period of two weeks thereafter in accordance with law and the law laid down in the case of Satender Kumar Antil versus Central Bureau of Investigation and another (supra).
With the aforesaid, the application/petition is disposed of.
.
